title: Five Star | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Stately beachfront Inlet Beach home with private beach access, community pool, pet friendly, and next to Rosemary Beach
description_expanded: Five Star Features - Gulf front home with panoramic Gulf views and furnished outdoor spaces on every floor - Adjacent to the private community beach entrance - Pet friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less, non-aggressive breeds only. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee required prior to arrival. Unauthorize pets will result in fines and possible eviction - Seasonally heated Gulf Front community pool, footsteps from the home and only shared with a handful of homes. The pool is heated over Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Years, and March 1 - Easter (subject to change by the HOA). - Access to 6 Taxi Bikes with your stay - Bike to Rosemary Beach in 2 minutes - 3 Minute bike ride to 30Avenues, with must visit upscale shopping and dining. A pedestrian bridge is available to safely travel from 30A to the popular shopping area. - 2nd Floor living room with Smart TV and DVD player - 2nd Floor dining area with Gulf views - 2nd Floor Kitchen with breakfast bar seating and Keurig coffee maker - 2nd and 3rd Floor Laundry centers - 2 King Suites. Each suite encompasses the entire floor, offering spacious retreats with romantic Gulf views - Driveway parking for 2 sedans or 1 oversized vehicle. Additional dedicated parking for 1 vehicle available next to the community pool entrance. - 6 Minute drive to the largest Publix Grocery Store in America - Concierge services available, including grocery delivery, baby equipment rentals, and more - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Five Star shines like a beacon atop the protected dunes of Inlet Beach. This spacious and stately home offers unparalleled Gulf views from every floor of the home, including in all bedrooms. Each floor of the home provides private Gulf facing outdoor spaces to further allow you to soak up all the sounds, sights, and sensations from the tranquil waters and soft white sands of 30A just outside your door. Located in the small residential community of The Bluffs at Inlet Beach, enjoy a private beach experience and seasonally heated community pool with a small number of homes. Renowned Rosemary Beach is footsteps away, and your crew will enjoy exploring the local shops and restaurants on the 6 Taxi Bikes available at the home. A family vacation is best when it includes the entire family, especially the furry family members. Five Star is pet friendly for up to two dogs. You and your pup will enjoy walking along the quiet streets of Inlet Beach and nearby Rosemary Beach. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
